results.name: Both Arms Behind on Wall Biceps Stretch
instructions: Stand upright facing away from a wall and place both palms facing upward against it behind your body with your arms fully extended.
Bend your knees slowly while keeping your hands against the wall until you feel a gentle stretch in your upper arms and shoulders.
Keep your elbows fully extended, your chest up, and hold the stretch for the desired duration.
Return to starting position to release tension.
tips: Keep both elbows fully extended throughout the stretch.
Stand tall and avoid leaning your torso forward.
Bend your knees gradually, reaching a comfortable stretch without feeling pain.
Breathe slowly and evenly while holding the stretch.
results.description: Both Arms Behind on Wall Biceps Stretch is a beginner single-joint isolation static exercise targeting the biceps (upper arms). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the flexibility category. Secondary muscles: Chest, Forearms.

results.name: Bulgarian Split Squat Stretch
instructions: Place your front foot flat on the floor and keep your torso upright.
Kneel in a split stance with your rear knee on the floor and the top of your rear foot resting against a wall behind you.
Gently shift your hips backward until you feel a comfortable stretch through the front of your rear thigh and hip.
Hold the stretch for the desired duration, then return to the starting position and repeat on the opposite side.
tips: Keep your torso upright throughout the stretch.
Keep your hips facing forward and avoid twisting your pelvis.
Shift your hips backward gradually until you feel a gentle stretch without pain.
Breathe slowly and evenly while holding the stretch.
results.description: Bulgarian Split Squat Stretch is a beginner single-joint isolation static exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the flexibility category. Secondary muscles: Glutes, Hamstrings, Core.

results.name: Calve Stretch Foot on Wall
instructions: Stand facing a wall and place both hands against it for support. Position the ball of one foot against the wall with your heel off the wall, while your opposite foot remains behind you for balance.
Keep your stretching leg straight and slowly lean your body toward the wall until you feel a stretch in your calf.
Hold the stretch while keeping your heel firmly in contact with the floor.
Return to the starting position with control and repeat before switching legs.
tips: Lean forward gradually until you feel a comfortable stretch without pain.
Keep both hips facing the wall to maintain proper alignment.
Inhale as you prepare and exhale as you lean into the stretch.
results.description: Calve Stretch Foot on Wall is a beginner single-joint isolation static exercise targeting the calves (lower legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the flexibility category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings.

results.name: Calve Stretch From Wall to Floor
instructions: Stand facing a wall and place both hands against it for support. Step one foot forward near the wall and extend your opposite leg straight behind you.
Slowly lean your body toward the wall, bending your front leg at the knee joint , while straightening your back leg.
Hold the stretch when you feel it in the calf of your back leg, keeping your heel as on the floor.
Return to the starting position with control and repeat before switching legs.
tips: Keep your back leg straight throughout the stretch.
Lean forward gradually until you feel a comfortable stretch.
Inhale before leaning forward and exhale as you deepen the stretch.
results.description: Calve Stretch From Wall to Floor is a beginner single-joint isolation static exercise targeting the calves (lower legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the flexibility category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings.

results.name: Calves Stretch on Step
instructions: Stand on the edge of a step with the balls of both feet on the platform and your heels hanging off the edge. Place both hands against a wall for support.
Keep your legs straight and slowly lower your heels below the level of the step until you feel a stretch in your calves.
Hold the stretch while keeping your movements relaxed and controlled.
Raise your heels back to the starting position with control and repeat for the desired number of repetitions or hold time.
tips: Lower your heels slowly to deepen the stretch without bouncing.
Keep the balls of your feet firmly on the edge of the step.
Stretch only until you feel a comfortable pull in your calves, not pain.
Inhale before lowering your heels and exhale as you deepen the stretch.
results.description: Calves Stretch on Step is a beginner single-joint isolation static exercise targeting the calves (lower legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the flexibility category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings.

results.name: Child Pose Lower Back Stretch
instructions: Kneel on the floor with your big toes together and knees apart.
Sit your hips back toward your heels.
Reach your arms forward and lower your chest toward the floor.
Rest your forehead down and breathe deeply into your lower back.
tips: Keep your knees closer together for a deeper back stretch.
Relax your shoulders.
results.description: Child Pose Lower Back Stretch is a beginner single-joint isolation static exercise targeting the spine (back). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the flexibility category. Secondary muscles: Lats, Glutes.

results.name: Cobra Stretch
instructions: Lie face down with your legs extended and the tops of your feet resting on the floor. Place your hands beneath your shoulders with your elbows close to your body.
Press through your hands to slowly lift your chest while extending your arms and keeping your hips in contact with the floor.
Raise your chest until you feel a comfortable stretch through your lower back and abdomen while keeping your shoulders relaxed.
Hold the stretch briefly, then slowly lower your chest back to the starting position with control.
tips: Keep your hips and legs in contact with the floor throughout the stretch.
Press up gradually and avoid forcing your lower back into excessive extension.
Keep your elbows close to your body as you lift your chest.
Exhale as you lift your chest and inhale as you lower back down.
results.description: Cobra Stretch is a beginner single-joint isolation static exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the flexibility category. Secondary muscles: Chest, Shoulders, Lower Back.

results.name: Crescent Moon Pose Quad Stretch With Block
instructions: Begin in a lunge position with one foot forward and your back knee resting on the floor. Bend your back knee and reach behind you to grasp your back foot with both hands.
Gently draw your back heel toward your glutes while keeping your chest lifted and your hips facing forward.
Hold the stretch until you feel a comfortable stretch along the front of your back thigh and hip.
Release your foot with control, return to the starting position, and repeat on the opposite side.
tips: Keep your front knee directly above your ankle.
Engage your core to help maintain balance and alignment.
Keep your chest lifted and avoid leaning excessively forward.
Inhale before deepening the stretch and exhale as you gently pull your foot closer.
results.description: Crescent Moon Pose Quad Stretch With Block is a beginner single-joint isolation static exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the flexibility category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors, Glutes, Core.

results.name: Cross Body Elbow Pull Shoulder Stretch
instructions: Stand upright with your feet shoulder width apart and your arms relaxed by your sides. Bend one arm behind your lower back with your elbow pointing outward.
Reach across your body with your opposite hand and grasp the elbow of your bent arm.
Gently pull the elbow across your body until you feel a comfortable stretch in the your shoulder.
Hold the stretch, then slowly release and repeat on the opposite side.
tips: Pull your elbow gently without forcing it beyond a comfortable range.
Maintain a slow, steady pull rather than using quick movements.
Keep your neck relaxed and your shoulders away from your ears.
Inhale before applying the stretch and exhale as you gently deepen it.
results.description: Cross Body Elbow Pull Shoulder Stretch is a beginner single-joint isolation static exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the flexibility category. Secondary muscles: Rotator Cuff, Upper Back, Chest.

results.name: Cross Body Shoulder Stretch
instructions: Stand upright with your feet shoulder width apart and your arms relaxed by your sides.
Raise one arm straight across the front of your chest at shoulder height.
Grasp your upper arm just above the elbow with your opposite hand and gently pull it closer to your chest while keeping your shoulders relaxed.
Hold the stretch, then slowly release and repeat on the opposite side.
tips: Pull from your upper arm rather than your forearm or wrist.
Keep your shoulders level and avoid shrugging them toward your ears.
Stretch only until you feel a comfortable pull in the back of your shoulder.
Inhale before applying the stretch and exhale as you gently pull your arm closer.
results.description: Cross Body Shoulder Stretch is a beginner single-joint isolation static exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the flexibility category. Secondary muscles: Upper Back, Rotator Cuff.
